_comment: Exact text replacements applied by rebrand/rebrand.py to a copy of the upstream client source: product names and paths, the control server (brand.json), and privacy edits (no log upload, no bootstrap DNS through third-party relays, no update check, and others). Each 'old' text must be found, so an upstream change cannot silently skip an edit.
